monitored_text: Service Overview CNC Manufacturing Services eMachineShop offers CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, injection molding, 3D printing, and more. Learn more about our capabilities below or upload your design for a fast quote . 50+ Materials. FREE Shipping in the USA. Guaranteed to meet your specs. Customers Include: Manufacturing Capabilities eMachineShop offers high quality CNC machined parts from a wide variety of materials. Our advanced CNC machinery, including CNC mills and lathes, and experienced machinists enable us to manufacture virtually any part. Our custom CNC manufacturing capabilities include: CNC Machining Mills and lathes cut material into almost any 3D shape. CNC machines can work with tight tolerances. Sheet Metal Fabrication Laser cutters and waterjets cut sheet material into almost any 2D shape. Press brakes can add complex bends as well. Injection Molding Injection molding machines can create complex plastic parts in moderate to high quantities at low cost. 3D Printing 3D printers create metal and plastic parts in low quantities at low cost and quickly. Why should you make your parts with eMachineShop? eMachineShop offers: Competitive pricing One-stop shopping via a wide variety of processes Large selection of materials and finishes Friendly customer service Option of using our free CAD software with instant feedback and pricing Design wizards and parts library Experience in a wide variety of industries Thousands of satisfied customers Free shipping in the USA Parts guaranteed to meet your specs eMachineShop Manufactured Parts Surface Finishing Treat the surface of your parts with anodizing, electroplating, buff polishing, powder coating, black oxide and more. These finishes can be used to protect your parts or change their appearance. Our powder coat service is one of the cost effective and fastest options. Secondary Processes Our secondary processes allow you to bend sheet metal parts into complex shapes such as brackets, trays, enclosures, etc. Knurling creates a textured grip on turned parts. Countersinking offers a way to make flat head screws flush with a surface. Reaming creates high precision holes. Threading allows for a wide variety of mating options. Easily order your custom manufactured parts eMachineShop offers fast quotes for your custom manufactured parts. Our customer service team will work with you to ensure your design specs are met. Order your parts easily by following these steps: Upload your CAD file or Create it – D upload your CAD files, PDF drawings, or images … or design your parts using our free CAD. Configure your job – Select from over 50+ materials and surface finishes. Enter quantity, address and any special comments. Receive a quote – Get a quote for your design (instantly via our CAD).
